tutorial_steps.text_content: Welcome to The Republia Post
Let's get you started
First, check the newspaper on your desk.
Always pay attention to your table.
That's where you'll find what cases you need to research.
Moving on, go check your phone
Since you're at work, it's pretty limited, but still useful
You'll receive messages now and then.
You can save some messages as a note, which might come in handy.
You can also delete them if you want to.
You can explore that later.
Try closing it by clicking the button on the bottom of the phone.
Next up, the most important thing, your laptop.
There are 5 apps you can use here.
First up, the Email app.
You can click any of them to expand their contents.
You can choose to add it to the evidence bank or discard them.
You can exit apps by clicking the button on the top right.
Next, the Evidence Bank app.
You will be able to see an overview of the evidences you gather.
Clicking 'add' will send it to the AI Analysis.
Clicking 'trash' will send it to the trash bin.
Let's go back to the homescreen.
Let's open the AI Analysis app.
In here, you can compare articles and tips
You can navigate through the list by clicking 'Prev' or 'Next'.
Clicking 'Analyze' will give you a detailed breadown.
The breakdown will give you an overview of how credible the information is.
Let's move onto the next app.
Open the Article Publisher.
Evidences that you have analyzed will appear here.
Clicking on the articles will add them to the publishing paper (right side).
You can add up to 4 articles.
Publishing the articles will remove them from your article list.
Let's move to the next app.
Open the trash bin.
This one's simple, you can restore any discarded information or just leave them be.
That's all for the laptop. Let's go back
You can close the laptop anytime by clicking 'Exit Laptop'
Lastly, the Integrity Meter, it's on the left side of the screen.
As its name suggest, it's a visualization of your integrity.
If you publish articles that are not 'credible' your integrity reduces.
We have provided you with a textbook will all the information we just told you.
That's all for now, goodluck with your work.
